environment.description: Deployed identically but fronted by AWS ALB with associated WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 with SizeRestriction_QUERYSTRING rule overridden to COUNT, (2) a custom rule group 'inventory-api-input-validation' at priority 200 containing a regex match rule on query string values matching pattern ['";\-\-] with BLOCK action and TextTransformation of URL_DECODE followed by LOWERCASE, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 in default BLOCK mode with no rule overrides. CloudWatch metrics confirm all three rule groups are actively evaluating requests with non-zero BlockedRequests metric in the past 24h.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association
config.security_group_inbound: TCP/8080 from ALB security group only
config.cloudwatch_metrics: BlockedRequests > 0 for all three rule groups in trailing 24h
